output.summary: Turnover rose far more than in-state peers (38% median, up 5 points), so market tightening alone does not explain it. The HRIS-artifact hypothesis fails because payroll reconciles. The rise began before ShiftWise (Oct-Feb already 11/month, jump in March with the Saturday policy), so ShiftWise and Saturday effects are unproven. Pay is unbenchmarked: the market study is stale and the postings are anecdotal. Manager attribution is unreliable because the manager-of-record field is stale. Vacancies driving overtime is established. Do not punish managers or commit to a 15% irreversible raise now. Get branch-level separations, the ShiftWise comparison and a pay benchmark before the January cycle.
